displayport_requirement.status: Required; existing kernel DSC/FEC path, physical compressed-image acceptance open
displayport_requirement.implementation: DPU DSC encoder and DisplayPort packet/FEC engines; CDSP preprocessing must preserve their buffer and timing contract
displayport_requirement.fec_role: Forward error correction, not image compression

current_observation.cdsp_state: offline after coordinator reboot; manual-start policy unchanged

displayport_requirement.existing_scope: RGB8/10-bpc input, fixed8 compressed bpp, at most two slices; no universal format/topology claim
displayport_requirement.physical_gate: Visible static/moving compressed image, valid receiver DSC/FEC/counters, presentation and USB continuity, safe plain-output recovery; DP alone then dual display
displayport_requirement.history: Earlier recorded compressed-image/FEC failures remain open; inactive zero counters do not establish enabled-link health

memc_requirement.status: Required; not implemented or physically qualified
memc_requirement.operation: Motion estimation and motion-compensated intermediate-frame synthesis, not duplication or blending
memc_requirement.candidate_backend: CDSP; firmware-matched operation, ABI and sustained performance unqualified
memc_requirement.first_workload: Bounded off-screen30-to60fps sequence; no display-mode change or high-resolution/120/144fps promise
required_contracts: Independent intermediate-frame references and scene-cut/occlusion handling
Declared color, precision and audio/video timing
Translated buffers, fences and restart-safe lifetime
Deadline, memory, sustained thermal/power and input-latency measurements
Explicit caller selection and original-frame path
Separate and combined DSC/MEMC acceptance with single/dual display

hdmi_compression_requirement.status: Required where the physical route supports it; current HDMI FRL/DSC not advertised
hdmi_compression_requirement.algorithm: Negotiated standard DSC; distinguish DP compression before converter decode from DSC on the HDMI link
hdmi_compression_requirement.transport_requirement: Compressed HDMI requires FRL and compatible converter/transmitter and display; a protocol version label alone is insufficient
